summary: Partition of ancestral properties; 1/6th share to plaintiff in ancestral properties, 1/3rd in self-acquired properties; validity of compromise between siblings declared invalid; legal heirs as parties; mesne profits entitlement established; Letters Patent Appeal dismissed by High Court; co-parcenary rights under Hindu law upheld; settlement deed dated 20.07.1985 not binding.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment affirming Trial Court's partition decree upheld; compromise set aside; shares in ancestral and self-acquired properties confirmed as 1/6th and 1/3rd; mesne profits granted from suit institution date.
